Registers scripts/claude_confirm_hook.py as a PreToolUse hook for every tool call — the script decides approve/block itself (see app/services/tools.is_dangerous), so the matcher intentionally covers all tools rather than a subset. Verified against a real, logged-in `claude` CLI (v2.1.215): this hooks JSON shape (hooks.PreToolUse[].matcher/hooks[].type=command/command/timeout) and the $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR variable both work as expected.
